messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena@novariotech.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Jan 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: NovarioTech case study draft: edits and pricing clarifications

Hi Elena —

Thanks again for the time last week. Attached is the third draft of the NovarioTech case study (Novario_case_draft_v3.docx) — we focused the narrative on the latency and cost improvements you highlighted, and I added a short sidebar about the Dedicated cluster you provisioned.

Quick asks:
- Can you confirm the phrasing under Results where we quote "~40% token cost reduction"? I pulled that from the summary your infra team shared; happy to soften it to a range if you'd prefer.
- We included one short quote attributed to Rajiv on rollout speed. Please confirm wording or supply alternate.
- There's a small pricing appendix (pdf) that lists the discount bands we referenced during procurement; we will remove any pricing specifics if that makes legal/comms easier.

If this looks good, we'd love a final sign-off for publish and a headshot you want used for the callout.

Attachments: Novario_case_draft_v3.docx (draft case study, tracked changes enabled), novario_pricing_appendix_v1.pdf (reference only)

Best,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive
Redwood Inference
[jordan.blake@redwood.com]

From: Elena Rossi <elena@novariotech.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Rajiv Kumar <rajiv.kumar@novariotech.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Jan 2026 11:03:00 +01:00
Subject: Re: NovarioTech case study draft: edits and pricing clarifications

Jordan —

Thanks for sending this over. We reviewed with the product and legal teams and have a few redlines and questions, inline below. I pasted the key points first for visibility.

Top-level items:
1) Results phrasing: please change "~40% token cost reduction" to "up to 40% token cost reduction for batch-heavy inference workloads" — we want to avoid implying savings for all workloads.
2) Dedicated cluster detail: good to mention, but please remove the specific cluster size ("8xA100") — that's sensitive.
3) Quote: Rajiv is happy to provide a short quote but would prefer: "Redwood's routing and caching cut inference latency and predictable cost materially for our nightly processing"
4) Pricing appendix: Legal requests you redact explicit discount percentages and replace with "contact sales for pricing details"

Inline changes (high level):
- Intro paragraph: reword second sentence to note we use Redwood for both "low-latency customer-facing features and bulk offline reranking" rather than "customer-facing features and batch jobs".
- Metrics table: swap the order so latency improvements appear before cost.

I attached a PDF with annotated comments (we couldn't edit the docx directly). Let me know if any of that is a problem. Happy to route final sign-off to our CMO if needed, but Rajiv can sign the technical accuracy confirmation.

Thanks,
Elena
Head of Product
NovarioTech

Attachment: Novario_comments_v1.pdf

Elena —

Appreciate the detailed pass and the annotated PDF. We made the edits you requested and produced two versions: one with the sensitive technical specifics redacted and one retaining them for internal review. I've attached the redacted public version (Novario_case_public_v1.docx). Key changes summarized:
- Results: updated phrasing to "up to 40% token cost reduction for batch-heavy inference workloads" and reordered metrics so latency appears first.
- Dedicated cluster: removed the explicit "8xA100" reference and replaced with "a dedicated GPU cluster".
- Quote: replaced with Rajiv's suggested language — thanks for that.
- Pricing appendix: removed percentages and added the line "contact sales for pricing details".

Monica & Marissa — could you confirm the redacted public version is okay to publish? If so, Elena, we'll prepare the final layout and send a publication preview for your brand team's review; we can route final sign-off to your CMO if that is required.

Attachments: Novario_case_public_v1.docx, novario_pricing_appendix_public.pdf

Best,
Jordan
